name: Six-Month Cycle MACD (Sy Harding Oct 16 / Apr 20 seasonal switch)
author: Sy Harding / Yale Hirsch (via StockCharts)
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
instruments_timeframes: Daily equity index in source; crypto applicability untested.
entry_long: On/after October 16 (next trading day if weekend): buy if MACD is bullish (above signal line or positive); otherwise buy when MACD turns bullish after Oct 16.
entry_short: Optional: short in bearish season from Apr 20 once MACD is bearish.
exit: On/after April 20: sell if MACD is bearish (below signal line or negative); otherwise sell when MACD turns bearish after Apr 20. Stay out (or short) during the bearish season.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Harding also anticipates the cycle with MACD tweaks (not captured). Calendar rule is explicit; MACD params not stated on page (default assumed).
